profile.summary: Customer-oriented IT Developer/Analyst with experience in managing and delivering complex solutions for Flight, In-Flight, Learning Technologies, Marketing, Finance, Purchasing, and IT departments. Major strengths in on-time, on-budget delivery of business systems and support applications in a fast-paced, service-oriented environment. Expertise is in meeting business strategies through innovative, cost effective technology solutions. Fluent: English/Spanish (read, write, and translate.) Background includes strong understanding of requirements, design, development, and testing.
